messages.content: It's extremely hot today and my air conditioner is currently turned off. Set it to start cooling at 20 degrees Celsius mid wind strength. power off after an hour

function.name: ThinQ_Connect
function.description: Sends a command to control an appliance, allowing only a single value to be sent in one call. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

body.description: A dictionary containing the parameters for the appliance command.

airConJobMode.description: The current job mode of the air conditioner.

windStrength.description: The strength of the air flow.

monitoringEnabled.description: Whether air quality sensor monitoring is enabled.

airCleanOperationMode.description: The operation mode for the air cleaning function.

airConOperationMode.description: The operation mode for the air conditioner, indicating if it is turned on or off.

powerSaveEnabled.description: Whether power save mode is enabled to conserve energy.

targetTemperature.description: The target temperature to set for the appliance, in degrees Celsius.

relativeHourToStop.description: The number of hours from the current time when the appliance should stop. If set to null, the appliance will not be scheduled to stop.

relativeMinuteToStop.description: The number of minutes from the current time when the appliance should stop. If set to null, the appliance will not be scheduled to stop.

relativeHourToStart.description: The number of hours from the current time when the appliance should start. If set to null, the appliance will not be scheduled to start.

relativeMinuteToStart.description: The number of minutes from the current time when the appliance should start. If set to null, the appliance will not be scheduled to start.

message.reasoning:
We need to parse user request: "Set it to start cooling at 20 degrees Celsius mid wind strength. power off after an hour". They want to start cooling at 20°C with mid wind strength, and power off after an hour. So we need to set airConJobMode to COOL, targetTemperature 20, windStrength MID, airConOperationMode POWER_ON? Actually they want to start cooling, so operation mode should be POWER_ON. Then schedule to power off after an hour: relativeHourToStop=1, relativeMinuteToStop=0. Also relativeHourToStart and relativeMinuteToStart? They want to start cooling now? They didn't specify start time, but maybe start immediately. So relativeHourToStart=0, relativeMinuteToStart=0? Or leave null? The function expects relativeHourToStart and relativeMinuteToStart. If we want to start immediately, we can set them to 0. But maybe we can leave them null to start immediately? The description says: "The number of hours from the current time when the appliance should start. If set to null, the appliance will not be scheduled to start." That means if we set null, it won't schedule to start; but we want to start now. So we should set relativeHourToStart=0, relativeMinuteToStart=0. Or we could set airConOperationMode to POWER_ON and leave start times null, meaning it will start immediately? The description: "relativeHourToStart: The number of hours from the current time when the appliance should start. If set to null, the appliance will not be scheduled to start." It doesn't say that if null, it will start immediately. It just says no schedule. But we want to start now. So we set relativeHourToStart=0, relativeMinuteToStart=0.

Also we need to set airConJobMode to COOL, windStrength to MID, targetTemperature to 20, airConOperationMode to POWER_ON, relativeHourToStop=1, relativeMinuteToStop=0. Others can be default or omitted.

Let's construct body accordingly.
